Committee: Veterans and Military Affairs
Sponsor: Butler
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 01/12/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 28 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Alabama National Guard, by an undetermined amount, dependent upon Congress approving, on or before FY 2025, the creation of a U.S. Space National Guard unit in the National Defense Authorization Act.
Tom Butler, Chairperson
Veterans and Military Affairs

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 28 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of the Alabama National Guard by an undetermined amount dependent upon Congress approving, on or before Fiscal Year 2025, the creation of a U.S. Space National Guard unit in the National Defense Authorization Act.
Dickie Drake, Chair
Military and Veterans Affairs
